title: BARCELONA AND REAL MADRID AGREE ON ONE THING: THIS 19-YEAR-OLD
description:
The press already calls him the new Rodri. He is 19. No pressure.

Luka Vuskovic, Brighton's Croatian centre-back, is being chased by both Barcelona and Real Madrid.

ESPN says Brighton signed him from Tottenham this summer for £46 million, which leaves Tottenham watching the bidding from the sofa. His contract runs to June 2031, and Brighton are expected to listen to offers at the end of the season.

So Brighton are in no hurry. Neither, it seems, is the price tag.
